description:
At Huawei we are looking for people who share our vision: to enrich life through communication. Providing technical support to customers across Europe, we are offering a challenging position, the opportunity to grow and expend your technical knowledge through daily interaction with R&D engineers located in Romania and having access to products in a laboratory environment.


Responsibilities

⎯ Troubleshoot hardware and software issues and identify network/applications issues;

⎯ Connect and collect remotely logs necessary for analysis (for project where applicable);

⎯ Provide detailed information on how to set up, configure, and upgrade Core Network

Products;

⎯ Use various department tools, technical knowledge, lab equipment, and on-line

resources for customer issue resolution;

⎯ Use trouble ticket system for tracking customer interactions and issue resolution;

⎯ Evaluate customers concerns and resolve problems to customer satisfaction;

⎯ Follows up with customer to ensure first call resolution and achieve and deliver 100%

customer satisfaction.

 

Requirements

⎯ Fluent English language;

⎯ Customer service experience, technical support and troubleshooting skills;

⎯ Self-starter, capable of taking initiative to identify & solve problems, and improve work

environment;

⎯ Ability to work on multiple tasks at the same time and prioritize them accordingly;

⎯ Excellent interpersonal and communication skills;

⎯ Good team spirit and adaptability.

⎯ Technical degree in Engineering/Telecommunications;

⎯ Generally minimum of 2 years of IT/ telecommunications experience;

⎯ Familiarity with the following protocols (SS7, EMM, ESM, SIP, RTP), solutions or products:

CS (MSC, MGW, HLR), IMS (CSCF, MGCF), PS (SGSN, GGSN); 5G Architecture

⎯ CCNA/HCIA qualification is considered an advantage;

⎯ Experience with Huawei Core Network products is considered a big advantage.
